title: INTERVAL — MONTH_24 table
description: Array of donor records. One element is one donor at the 24-month contact (end of Phase I): the 24-month questionnaire, cognitive test, physical activity monitor and the 24-month blood sample. A blank in the provider's data is written as an empty string; the dictionary's own codes are kept as constants.
$comment: Category files are wired into allOf as each category is converted. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of rows: the dictionary lists no participant identifier (D010/D011).
